description: Capture the current page, or one element, as a PNG or JPEG. In a supervised session this is, like get_a11y_tree, a fresh observation after a person hands control back. With no session_id and no active session, pass url instead for a one-shot capture in a throwaway browser. API docs: https://roveapi.com/docs.

frame.description: A CSS selector for an iframe, or a list of them for nested iframes. selector, label and ref then resolve inside it.

full_page.description: Capture the full scrollable page, not just the viewport. In-session only. Default: false.

page_id.description: The page to act on, from list_pages or pages_opened. Defaults to the current page. Does not change the current page.

ref.description: An element ref from this page's latest get_a11y_tree, such as e5, or f1e3 inside an iframe.

selector.description: CSS selector to capture a specific element instead of the page. In-session only.

session_id.description: Browser session ID. Defaults to this connection's active session. Omit, with no active session, for a one-shot capture of url.

url.description: URL for a one-shot capture in a throwaway browser. Ignored when there is a session.

name: screenshot
title: Take screenshot
